name: Exec Cluster E17: Triple Exit Stack — SL + Trail + TP
description: Tests: stacking stop_loss + trailing_stop + take_profit (first triggered wins)
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E17: Triple Exit Stack (First Triggered Wins)
# Tests: stop_loss + trailing_stop + take_profit coexistence
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === VOLATILITY ===
atr_val = atr(src.h, src.l, src.c, 14)

# === SIGNAL: Donchian breakout ===
donchian = donchian_channel(src.h, src.l, window=20)
upper = donchian.donchian_upper >> 1
lower = donchian.donchian_lower >> 1

entry_long = close > upper
entry_short = close < lower
held_long = hold_until(entry_long, entry_short)
held_short = hold_until(entry_short, entry_long)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Fixed sizing (NOT risk_unit, so we can use standalone stops)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=15)

# E17: Triple exit stack — first triggered wins
# 1. Disaster stop (floor)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)

# 2. Trail tightens as trade profits (with activation)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 2, activation=atr_val)

# 3. Cap at 15% profit
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=15)
